records.title: ux(ci): gate-critical workflow steps block when the operator opted into blocking
records.release_claim: explicit blocking mode cannot go green merely because a load-bearing report, SARIF, upload, or gate artifact step failed under continue-on-error
records.reason: The prior generated workflow swallowed failures even after the operator selected a blocking mode, contradicting the gate contract and nonzero-exit proof.
records.non_claim: Generated CI remains advisory when no blocking gate mode is configured.

records.title: docs(release): state the cross-repository release identity and audit contract
records.release_claim: ripr-swarm owns development and rehearsal while source ripr owns public release, publishing, signing, and distribution
records.reason: The replacement freeze and promotion can only be reviewed safely when the two repository authorities and exact-candidate audit boundary are explicit.
records.non_claim: Swarm evidence does not authorize source publication or mutate source release state.

records.title: docs(cli): update stale 0.8.0 version references to 0.10.0
records.release_claim: checked-in examples name the development version and VSIX filename represented by that tree
records.reason: The swarm correction is valid history, but the final source candidate must resolve these references to the separately staged 0.10.1/0.11.0 release train rather than copying 0.10.0 blindly.
records.non_claim: This swarm documentation commit is not evidence that 0.10.0 or 0.11.0 was publicly released.

records.title: ux(ci): cache Cargo registry, Git, and dependency builds in the generated workflow
records.release_claim: generated CI avoids paying a cold dependency and install cost on every PR while still installing the selected RIPR version freshly
records.reason: The release narrative includes a usable generated-CI path; the prior repeated cold install cost materially impaired that path and interacted with the gate-critical workflow group.
records.non_claim: The cache does not reuse RIPR analysis output or bypass installing the requested tool version.

records.title: docs(release): document RIPR source-tarball contents
records.release_claim: release review knows which tests, fixtures, examples, schemas, docs, and assets the crate package includes
records.reason: Package-content review and later publish-dry-run qualification need an explicit baseline, but this does not change runtime behavior.
records.non_claim: Documented contents do not by themselves prove the package was published or installable.

records.title: docs(agents): add the finding verification contract
records.release_claim: repository issue intake requires source identity, reproduction evidence, all-state search, overlap checks, and bounded classification
records.reason: This protects contributor process but is not required by the shipped CLI, LSP, package, or release claim.
records.non_claim: The prose contract is not yet a machine-enforced issue-intake validator.

records.title: refactor: extract a shared Git helper
records.release_claim: none; introduces one shared helper without migrating existing call sites
records.reason: The helper and process-policy registration are behavior-neutral scaffolding. It may ship with the current tree, but no release claim depends on it until consumers migrate.
records.non_claim: The four existing Git implementations still own their current behavior in this commit.
